title: BUGFIX — fal.ai scene generation ETIMEDOUT: outer Python subprocess hangs after kill, blocking Node execSync
rationale: fal-video-client.ts outer Python script kills inner proc on timeout, then calls proc.communicate(timeout=5) to drain pipes. But fal_client spawns grandchildren that inherit the pipe's write-end, so communicate() blocks for the full 5s then passes. Python takes ~90s to exit. Node execSync timeout is 120s — should have 30s buffer, but actual Python cleanup can exceed it. Fix: use start_new_session=True (new process group) + os.killpg(SIGKILL) to kill the entire process group, then proc.wait(timeout=3) instead of communicate — no pipe drain needed after group kill. Also bump Node execSync timeout 120s→150s for safety margin.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/fal-video-client.ts: change outer Python script to use start_new_session=True + os.killpg(os.getpgid(proc.pid), signal.SIGKILL) to kill entire process group on timeout. Replace proc.communicate(timeout=5) with proc.wait(timeout=3). Add signal import to outer script. Bump Node execSync timeout from 120000 to 150000.
